summary: First-finish smoke test of CineMind AI. Seeded session via mongosh per auth_testing.md and verified full backend + frontend flow. All 15 backend endpoints pass. All 6 frontend pages render with correct testids and expected content. App works fully in demo mode with no real Ollama/Trakt/Simkl/Plex credentials.
passed: GET /api/auth/me returns user with Bearer token after mongosh seeding
GET /api/connections returns defaults; PUT /api/connections persists fields; re-GET confirms persistence
GET /api/history seeds 12 demo items on first call
GET /api/history/stats returns total=12, movies=6, shows=6, genres[], sources[], avg_rating=8.38, hours_estimate=72
POST /api/history/sync with no real creds returns {count:12, demo:true}
POST /api/taste-profile/generate returns cinematic_dna, key_tropes(list), mood, narrative_complexity, top_genres, used_demo:true
POST /api/recommendations/{id}/save flips saved=true; GET /api/recommendations/saved shows it (count=1)
After seeding session_token cookie, /dashboard loads with sync-history-button, stat cards (12/6/6/72h), genre bars, sources
/recommendations shows movie cards with save/dismiss/info actions (7 after prior dismiss)
/saved renders the saved Poor Things pick (screenshot verified)

notes.mocked_apis_confirmed: Ollama/Trakt/Simkl/Plex fall back to DEMO data as designed. Simkl test endpoint returned ok:true because Simkl public API accepts empty creds with 200; Trakt returned 403 (expected without valid client_id); Ollama and Plex correctly reported 'not configured'.
notes.note_on_generate_demo_flag: POST /api/recommendations/generate returned demo:false when ollama_url was persisted as empty string ''. Backend correctly still returned count=8 (fell back to DEMO_RECS on connection failure). Not a functional issue.
notes.test_credentials_file: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty; used mongosh session seeding per /app/auth_testing.md.
